fields.summary_ko.0: Samsung Electronics (005930) has declined more than 50% from its peak, but with cumulative operating profit forecasts reaching KRW 1,021 trillion over two years, the gap between earnings and stock price is at a historic maximum, with a PER of 3x indicating undervaluation.
fields.summary_ko.1: Daishin Securities presents 12-month forward PERs of 2.67x and 2.2x for Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix (000660) respectively, proposing large-cap semiconductors as primary targets for staged purchases.
